description: We are Team Glitch, building ArtemisLens—an AI-powered 3D lunar south pole mission simulator for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge. Using real NASA JPL Horizons ephemeris data and LRO elevation maps, our platform visualizes dynamic sun shadows, calculates solar power windows, and verifies Earth communication line-of-sight in real time. Looking for teammates in 3D web dev (Three.js/React), Python data pipelines, astrophysics, and storytelling to build a global-finalist prototype!
